observations.detail: Page loads successfully at http://localhost:3006, shows authentication screen initially, then renders main dashboard UI
Navigation bar is visible with all required tabs: Chats, Jobs, Git (GitHub), Workers, Knowledge, Research, Memory, Routing, Models
Navigation tabs work correctly - clicking Jobs, Workers, and Chats tabs successfully changes views and URLs
Jobs tab shows proper jobs list view with filters (status, users), search box, Refresh and Create Job buttons
UI adapts well to different screen sizes, navigation remains functional on tablet-sized viewport (800x600)
Layout is well-structured with clear visual hierarchy, consistent spacing, and no broken layouts
Multiple 401 Unauthorized errors from API calls due to missing authentication, but UI gracefully handles this with appropriate fallback messaging

tasteIssues.issue: API error messages displayed to user in red text could be better integrated into the UI design
tasteIssues.element: Error message display in Jobs view

tasteIssues.issue: Dark theme has good contrast but error text could be less prominent or better styled

summary: Main dashboard UI renders correctly and meets all specified requirements. Navigation works properly, layout is responsive, and the Jobs view displays as expected. The only issues are API authentication errors (401s) which are handled gracefully with appropriate fallback messaging, indicating the frontend is working correctly even without backend authentication.
